macro_context.market_sentiment: Broadly bullish risk-on environment: Nasdaq, S&P 500, and Russell 2000 all hit new records in early May 2026 fueled by AI earnings momentum and hopes of a U.S.-Iran peace deal, though most sectors outside tech saw modest pullbacks on May 7. Stocks rose sharply on Iran ceasefire reports before trimming gains.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% on April 29, 2026 in a historically divided 8-4 vote (Powell's final meeting as chair); markets are pricing in no cuts for the rest of 2026 or early 2027, as elevated inflation partly reflecting rising energy prices continues to constrain the FOMC.
macro_context.geopolitical: An active Iran war has disrupted global energy markets and shipping routes, pushing NAND/oil supply chains into uncertainty; stocks rallied on May 6-7 on reports of U.S.-Iran negotiations approaching a deal, with oil prices falling on the news. Additional flashpoints include U.S.-Venezuela tensions and NATO posture around Greenland.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Strong wave of target raises post-Q3 earnings: Susquehanna doubled target to $2,000 (from $1,000, maintains Buy); Bernstein raised to $1,700 (from $1,250, Outperform); Citigroup raised to $1,300 (from prior, Buy); RBC Capital raised to $1,000 (Sector Perform — most cautious). Goldman Sachs previously raised to $1,200 from $700 (Buy). Consensus is 13 Buys / 3 Holds, no current Sell ratings. No recent downgrades.

web_context.competitor_activity: Micron (MU) is sold out of all 2026 memory supply and reported Q1 FY2026 non-GAAP EPS of $4.78 (+57% YoY revenue), rising 125% YTD — a direct signal of industry-wide NAND/DRAM supply tightness that benefits SNDK pricing. Western Digital (WDC, SNDK's former parent) has its high-capacity drives fully committed to hyperscalers through fiscal year-end. Samsung is ramping high-density NAND but supply deficit not expected to close before early 2027. Kioxia (SNDK's JV partner) renewed manufacturing agreement through 2034, locking in supply. Bernstein flagged mixed spot-market signals suggesting memory demand softness at higher prices may temper the supercycle in H2 2026.
